name: Dead Air on the Black Channel
description: A pirate-radio rig has gone quiet, but its lab-network signal may still carry a recoverable broadcast record. Scan 172.20.0.0/24, where challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199, and recover the record from the rig.

tasks.name: Recover the broadcast record
tasks.description: The pirate-radio rig's transmission log is missing from the crew console. This challenge runs on the lab network: scan 172.20.0.0/24, where challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199, and recover the broadcast record from the rig.
hints: Compare the responses from the open ports; one may sound like a different kind of service than its port suggests.
The useful service speaks a familiar mail-transfer protocol. Check what its identity-verification feature can tell you.
Ask the service to verify the radio identity, then inspect the full reply for the record.
